source_row.english: The objects of the third division are names and forms, for the non-virtue in this case arises from a view about the virtues and non-virtues that are all part of names and forms in general. The objects of the last division are names, for lying and so forth all occur--ultimately--based on the names of things. 75 Some Ethical Questions
